architecture_summary: React SPA. Neobrutalist ThirtySpace design system. Hero page, bento component showcase, auth modal, app shell with nav. Tailwind for styling, thick borders + hard shadows.

tickets.title: Hero & Features Page
tickets.description: Build hero landing page from thirtyspace_hero_section. Big headline, subheading, CTA buttons with neobrutalist thick borders and hard drop shadows. Feature grid below hero showing core value props. Use bold typography, high-contrast colors, offset shadow effects.
acceptance_criteria: Hero section with headline + CTA rendered
Neobrutalist style: thick black borders, hard shadow offsets

tickets.title: Components Bento Showcase
tickets.description: Bento grid page merging thirtyspace_button_showcase, thirtyspace_badge_showcase, thirtyspace_component_showcase_inputs, thirtyspace_loader_showcase, thirtyspace_table_showcase, thirtyspace_sidebar_showcase, thirtyspace_404_navigation_bento_variant. Each component variant in its own bento cell. Buttons (primary/secondary/ghost/destructive), badges (status/count), inputs (text/select/checkbox/radio), loaders (spinner/progress), sample table with sortable headers, sidebar preview, 404 tile.
acceptance_criteria: Bento grid layout with varied cell sizes
All component categories rendered: buttons, badges, inputs, loaders, table, sidebar preview, 404
Each cell has neobrutalist border + offset shadow

tickets.title: Auth Modal Component
tickets.description: Login/Register modal from thirtyspace_login_register_mobile. Toggle tabs between Login and Register. Email + password fields, submit button, social auth stubs. Neobrutalist styling. Accepts isOpen + onClose props. Traps focus, closes on ESC and backdrop click.
acceptance_criteria: Form fields with validation UI states

tickets.title: App Shell + Navigation
tickets.description: Root App component. Top nav bar with ThirtySpace logo, links (Hero, Components), Login button opening AuthModal. Client-side view switcher between Hero and Components pages (useState-based, no router dep). Neobrutalist nav bar with thick bottom border. Manages AuthModal open state.
acceptance_criteria: Nav bar with logo + page links + Login button
View switching between Hero and Components pages
